_note: An attacker compromised the maintainer's npm account (credential reuse) and published 3 malicious versions (0.7.29, 0.8.0, 1.0.0) with a postinstall script that ran a cryptominer and password-stealer depending on OS. ua-parser-js was an extremely mature, popular package (millions of weekly downloads). This proves install-script signal fires despite high maturity/adoption — maturity and install-scripts are independent findings; popularity does not suppress exfil detection. Payload defanged to an inert REDACTED marker; only the SHAPE (lifecycle script that fetches + pipes remote code) is preserved.
